ai_summary: Bajaj Finserv delivered robust consolidated revenue growth in Q1 FY2027, primarily driven by strong performance and improving asset quality in its core lending businesses. However, headline profit growth for owners was significantly boosted by mark-to-market gains, with adjusted profit expanding only 5%, and both insurance subsidiaries reported substantial profit declines due to lower capital gains, raising a red flag about the quality and sustainability of overall group profitability.
